items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: Frank Moyer, Wiggins, and then Smitty.

ctx.x: That's for him first. Well naturally he got an every night job and that's all he'd do for a living. So he took an every night job. And Lionel told me, he said, I know a good piano player. I played with him before. He named him Smitty, he said. No Wiggins played before Smitty. No Wiggins, yeah Wiggins. Not Frank Moyer. Frank Moyer, Wiggins, and then Smitty. Wiggins didn't stay, well Wiggins didn't stay long. Because he went on another job. Yeah he went on another job. And then we got Smitty. And Smitty stayed…
What did, let me give you one thing straight, what did you call the band? What was the name of the band?
